author: OhLookItsDaOne
short: Update cog repos and reload cogs
description: Pulls the git repositories of all loaded cogs and reloads them (excluding itself). Sends a status embed with the result of each repository and reload.
install_msg: Cog installed. Use `[p]cogupdate` (owner only) to update and reload all cogs.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
